title: An A.I. Songwriting Experiment: Humans Against the Machine
source_used: The Verge (relaying The New York Times)
key_facts: The New York Times ran a songwriting experiment pitting five musicians against an AI
The Verge says the AI songs are weak and easy to tell apart from the human ones side by side
The Times piece documents the songwriting process of both humans and AI in diary style
The Verge's weekend editor Terrence O'Brien says the diary shows how low-effort AI music is
quote_evidence: The New York Times pitted five musicians against an AI in a songwriting competition.
Ok, let's be honest, it's not much of a competition. The AI songs suck, and it's pretty easy to tell which is human and which is AI when compared side by side.
why_it_matters_hint: A newspaper test lets readers hear for themselves how AI-made songs compare with human ones
notes: NYT page blocked (403); facts come from The Verge's short write-up, which is an opinionated blurb, so the detail is thin.
